name: Genealogy Of Jesus
overview: The genealogy of Jesus, as presented in Matthew and Luke, establishes His rightful place in the lineage of David and Abraham, affirming His fulfillment of Old Testament promises. Matthew emphasizes the structured progression of generations—fourteen from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the Babylonian exile, and fourteen from the exile to Christ—highlighting God's sovereign plan in history. Luke situates Jesus historically by noting the political rulers of the time and traces His lineage through Joseph, underscoring Jesus' humanity and His connection to God's redemptive purposes.
